objective: Maximize risk-adjusted cleared contribution profit per founder minute while compounding evidence, reusable delivery assets, recurring revenue, partner leverage, owner-independent fulfilment, privacy-safe learning, and enterprise value without inventing evidence or bypassing consequence controls.
goals: One private evidence-first economic operating system rather than a pile of disconnected SaaS clones.
Preserve the historical many-front-end-offers one-shared-operating-system doctrine while current evidence decides which offers are active now.
Lawfully discover and rank real opportunities by mechanism, evidence quality, downside, unit economics, recurrence, delivery feasibility, and founder minutes.
Turn opportunities into bounded offers, distribution experiments, accepted delivery, cleared payment, renewal, expansion, and trusted learning.
Operate founder-light with a small exact owner-action queue only where external identity, consequence, payment, legal, provider, or customer action is unavoidable.

Build elite multi-channel distribution across governed outbound, partners, referrals, product-led diagnostics, owned content, SEO/AEO, social/public distribution, communities/directories, marketplaces, agent ecosystems, reactivation, retention, renewal, and eventually paid media when measured economics justify it.
Preserve partner-first and white-label leverage including the historical Agency Revenue Watchtower and related recurring-product lineage without treating any unproven offer as active revenue.
Keep the primary brand protected while acquisition infrastructure, sender health, suppression, consent, provider terms, budget, and attribution remain explicit gates.

Continuously acquire missing capabilities from public software patterns using clean-room abstraction, dedupe, license review, provider-neutral contracts, hostile tests, and no automatic code vendoring.
Route work across deterministic code, tools, models, agents, and humans according to evidence and measured economics while capability never creates authority.
Preserve durable identities, proof DAG lineage, crash/replay safety, monotonic constraints, exact external-effect ledgers, contradiction preservation, revocation, and auditability.
Learn only from trusted observed outcomes; internal model prose, synthetic benchmarks, opens, clicks, CRM guesses, creator screenshots, and architecture cannot manufacture revenue or customer truth.
Compound every accepted delivery into reusable rules, templates, monitoring, recovery playbooks, privacy-safe learning, white-label capability, and recurring products.
Keep lite/ protected unless a separately justified mission explicitly requires changing it.

startupProtocol: Read AGENTS.md and UBERBOND_CANON.md before using chat memory as project truth.
Refresh live main and inspect open or recently merged shared PRs before selecting work.
Read UBERBOND_BOOTSTRAP.json and every path listed in canonPointers, including HISTORICAL_PROJECT_LINEAGE.md and docs/CURRENT_HANDOFF.json.
Read docs/CURRENT_SYSTEM_STATE.md and artifacts/system-readiness.json for current measured readiness.
Dedupe requested work against current main and active shared branches.
Select the highest-value dependency-satisfied unfinished mission that advances risk-adjusted cleared contribution profit per founder minute.
Execute inside the consequence charter, verify the exact head, and leave a durable handoff after material work.

continuity.startupInstruction: Repository canon outranks chat memory. New sessions resume by refreshing main and loading the bootstrap, every canon pointer, current readiness, and durable handoff before acting.
